Our story

How we began.

It all started in the most ordinary place—the office, where two people crossed paths without knowing that something beautiful was about to begin.

Time passed, conversations grew, and somewhere along the way, friendship turned into something more. After quite some time, we finally made it official and began writing our story together.

But our greatest chapter came when our daughter entered the world. She changed everything—in the most beautiful way. She gave our love a deeper meaning and our little story a bigger purpose.

From two people who simply met at work, to a family built on love, laughter, and countless memories… our journey has brought us here.

And now, we’re ready to begin our next chapter—together, forever.

Details

Good to know.

Getting there

Taytay and Cainta sit just east of Metro Manila in Rizal — roughly 30–60 minutes from most of the city. Free parking is available at both venues.

Can I bring a plus-one?

Your invitation names everyone we've saved a seat for. If it says "and guest," absolutely.

Are children welcome?

We love your little ones — there'll be a small kids' corner during dinner.

Gifts

Your presence is the gift. Should you wish to give more, a note toward our first home means the world.

With love

Your presence is our greatest gift.

Having you beside us on our day is everything we could hope for. Should you wish to share a little something more, a gift toward the home and life we're building together would mean the world — but it is never expected.
